compare-two-groups column {\"paired\":fa.notes: Assumes normal distributions but allows unequal variances (Welch–Satterthwaite df). Two-tailed P value.

compare-two-groups column {\"paired\":tr.subtitle: Paired t test
compare-two-groups column {\"paired\":tr.notes: Assumes the paired differences are sampled from a normal distribution. Two-tailed P value. Uses complete rows only (every subject measured in every group). 4 rows left out for missing data.

anova column {\"posthoc\":\"tukey\",\"se.subtitle: One-way ANOVA
anova column {\"posthoc\":\"tukey\",\"se.notes: Compares means across groups; assumes normal distributions with equal variances.

two-way-anova grouped {\"design\":\"ordi.subtitle: Ordinary two-way ANOVA
two-way-anova grouped {\"design\":\"ordi.notes: Compares group and row-position effects, plus their interaction; assumes normal distributions with equal variances (Type III sums of squares).
two-way-anova grouped {\"design\":\"ordi.comparisonsLabel: Tukey's multiple comparisons (groups within each row, each row a family)

multiple-t-tests grouped {\"paired\":fal.subtitle: Multiple t tests
multiple-t-tests grouped {\"paired\":fal.notes: Welch's t test (no equal-SD assumption) at each row, Holm-corrected across rows.

correlation-matrix multiple {\"method\":.subtitle: Pearson correlation matrix
correlation-matrix multiple {\"method\":.notes: Pearson correlation between every pair of variables, computed on pairwise-complete rows; assumes linear relationships.
